meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会一直盯住某个 PR:反复查看 CI 检查、评论和未解决的 review 线程,把真问题改在聚焦提交里并推送,直到检查通过、无可处理意见才停,不会只查一遍就收工。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、monitor 或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、评审和 CI,直到所有可处理问题都解决时接管。

say.text: 帮我 babysit #123 这个 PR,直到可以合并
say.note: 它会轮询状态、评论和 review 线程

say.text: 盯着 #123,CI 或评论有问题就修好并推送
say.note: 修完会回到检查步骤重来

say.text: 验证修复后,把 #123 上已过时的 review 线程标记为已解决
say.note: 只在确认代码已处理后才会 resolve

howto.what_en: Claude stays on a pull request: it watches CI, comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and re-checks until checks pass and no actionable items remain.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge
say_en.note: It polls status, comments and review threads

say_en.text: Keep watching #123 and fix any CI or comment issues, then push
say_en.note: After fixing it returns to the check step

say_en.text: Verify the fix, then resolve the outdated review threads on #123
say_en.note: Threads are resolved only after the code is confirmed fixed
